units: Ber. 38ᵇ Ar. ed. pr. (ed. Koh. a. Talm. ed. כרבא).—Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ bot.; Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᶜ top [read:] צם … אַפְּסַק כרובה (v. פִּסְקָא) fasted two days in succession on a last meal of cabbage, and died.—Pl. כְּרוּבָּתָא various species of cabbage, cmp. אִיסְפַּרְגּוֹס. Y. Ned.
